text: The Drainage Upgrading Projects, FY2021–FY2023 tranche, are part of Singapore's national flood resilience strategy led by PUB. These projects focus on reducing pluvial flood risks in the urbanized city through targeted upgrades of drainage infrastructure, operational optimization using the Source-Pathway-Receptor (SPR) approach, and digital monitoring. The initiative is supported by regulatory measures and involves collaboration with technology partners to enhance flood protection and water management.
